title: af/TaskCollected@1
description: The tombstone `af task gc --apply` writes into a finished Task's log (ADR-0135), carried inline by one `task_collected` TaskTransition@5 that references no artifact. It keeps the summary `af task list` and `af task show` print once the Task's artifacts may be gone. `collected_unix_ms` is no earlier than `last_event_unix_ms` and equals the transition's `now_unix_ms`, which the typed contract checks.

chargeable_tokens.description: Committed chargeable tokens as canonical decimal text.

collected_bytes.description: Bytes of the CAS objects this Task reached and no retained record reaches, as the preview computed them.
